articles.detail: 5 of 5 cycles completed, avg 10 published/cycle (64 yesterday)

experiment: Skipped — all four goals are met with margin, no active experiment was due for evaluation, and no noNewExperimentsUntil gate is set. The one queued item (2026-05-08-numerical-density) edits scripts/write-prompt.md, which is outside the daily-tuning surface, so it stays queued.
weakestArea: Top-source share is the metric closest to its limit: Dawn supplied 9 of 63 articles (14%), up from Al Jazeera's 7% lead yesterday, and three of today's Islamabad datelines (journalist detention, election commissioner, insect barcoding) come from it. Still 6 points under the 20% cap, and the other 49 sources hold at most 4 each, so this is worth watching rather than changing anything. Africa also halved, 10 to 5, all politics and health.
watching: The Iran/Gulf war cluster again spans categories — Iranian strikes on Jordan's Azraq base, Seoul weighing a Hormuz force, Bahrain naval drone defence, Iranian household borrowing, oil and Fed odds, Trump tying the war to the vote, and Mokha falling to the Houthis.
Three climate-extremes pieces landed on one day — August tying the heat record, a lengthening extreme-heat season, and El Niño nearing historic strength — distinct angles but one underlying story.
Europe recovered from 7 to 15 articles and now includes an EU economic thread (the EU's own Starlink) after yesterday's gap.
Science draws on nine distinct outlets for 13 articles, keeping the category off any single specialist source.
Freshness still rests on a thin base — 11 of 63 articles carry a measurable lag, down from 15 yesterday.
Yesterday's exact-title duplicate pairs remain live in content/articles/ (e.g. "Heart Inflammation Bet Fails Again", "Experts Sell Their Judgment"); no new collision was published today.
coverageGaps: Oceania has a single article (Wellington rat poison) and there is no Pacific island coverage for a fourth consecutive day.
Latin America appears only as Argentina's inflation print and Mexicali solar cooling — no Brazil, Andean or Central American story.
Africa fell to 5 articles, and none is economy or tech; the continent's coverage is Algeria–UAE, Sudan, Libya, Zimbabwean migrants and a Nigerian diphtheria outbreak.
South and Southeast Asia beyond Pakistan is thin — one Indian trade story, one Adani financing, one Philippine ferry fire.
context: The experiment slot has been empty since 2026-05-26 and every goal has passed on consecutive audits, so parametric tuning has nothing to act on. The open structural work flagged yesterday is unchanged and needs an operator decision: the title-overlap dedup layer in scripts/lib/dedup.js is gated to niche-only sources, and scripts/validate-articles.js has no duplicate-title or duplicate-URL gate. Both files are outside the tuning surface.
